answer: Based on final investment decisions taken to date, ArcelorMittal expects to reduce Scope 1 and 2 carbon-emissions intensity by up to 10% by 2030 versus 2018. The report identifies the transition at Dunkirk from two blast furnaces to one blast furnace and one electric arc furnace as an included action and says the transition plan can serve as a model for similar projects.

dependency.action: Dunkirk transition from two blast furnaces to one blast furnace and one electric arc furnace
